args.title: Fix get_or_compute silently swallowing compute failures
args.body:
## Problem
`get_or_compute` was catching all exceptions and silently returning the last cached value. This caused stale data to appear on dashboards with no indication that the upstream compute had failed.

## Fix
Changed the `except Exception` clause to re-raise as a `ValueError` with a descriptive message, preserving the original exception as the cause. This makes failures immediately visible and diagnosable.

## Change
```python
# Before
except Exception:
    return _last   # BUG: swallows the error silently

# After
except Exception as e:
    raise ValueError(f"compute failed: {e}") from e
```

Test `tests/test_cache.py::test_compute_failure_contract` now passes.
